propositions: usage-log rows record only token fields and lack model, provider, and timestamp needed for cost pricing
record() is extended to accept model and provider kwargs and stamps a UTC ISO timestamp internally, with the runner call site passing ran_model and inferred provider
a pure dict-to-kwargs adapter maps the four stored token fields into genai-prices usage input, defaulting absent fields to 0
summarize computes optional per-op estimated cost and a per-model rollup by pricing each row via genai-prices
pricing is attempted only when genai_prices imports; LookupError or unknown-model rows are unpriced silently, other errors WARN and are unpriced, and the summary notes excluded unpriced calls
when genai-prices is absent, summarize prints token totals with cost 'unavailable (install rebar[pricing])' and exits 0, and old-format rows still summarize
